props.description: Brand strings and logo image, fully i18n-ready

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names merged onto the root anchor

description:

Use `variant="danger"` for destructive actions like delete.

props.description: Button label / content

props.description: Stretches the button to fill its container width

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element rendered before the label

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner and disables interaction

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the button

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button

description:
Contact page's primary card: heading, intro, a prominent mailto CTA and
a bulleted list of suggested topics. All copy is supplied by the caller.

props.name: email
props.description: Contact email shown as the CTA

props.name: intro
props.description: Supporting intro paragraph

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading

props.name: topics
props.description: Bullet list of topics people can reach out about

props.name: topicsTitle
props.description: Heading above the topics list

description:
Full-width closing call-to-action banner with a decorative aurora
background and a single mail button. All copy and the link are
supplied by the caller.

props.name: body
props.description: Supporting copy under the heading

props.name: ctaHref
props.description: Button destination, e.g. "mailto:hello@example.com"

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: Button label, e.g. "Get in touch"

props.name: title
props.description: Banner heading

description:
Site footer with brand/tagline, contact email, grouped link columns and a
copyright bar. Purely presentational — no dates or strings are computed
internally, so the caller controls the copyright year and wording.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand strings and logo, forwarded to <Brand />

props.name: columns
props.description: Grouped link columns, e.g. Product / Company

props.name: copyright
props.description: Copyright line, e.g. "© 2026 OZSV. All rights reserved."

props.name: email
props.description: Contact email shown as a mailto link

props.name: emailAriaLabel
props.description: aria-label for the email link

props.name: meta
props.description: Secondary meta line shown next to the copyright, e.g. "Made in Australia"

props.name: tagline
props.description: Short tagline shown under the brand mark

description:
Sticky site header with brand, primary navigation, theme toggle and a
collapsible mobile menu. Owns only its own open/closed UI state — all
copy and links are supplied by the caller.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand strings and logo, forwarded to <Brand />

props.name: closeMenuLabel
props.description: aria-label for the mobile menu button when the menu is open

props.name: openMenuLabel
props.description: aria-label for the mobile menu button when the menu is closed

props.name: primaryNav
props.description: Primary navigation links, shown inline on desktop and in the mobile sheet

props.name: themeGroupLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the theme toggle radiogroup

props.name: themeLabel
props.description: Label shown next to the theme toggle in the mobile menu

props.name: themeOptions
props.description: Theme toggle options, forwarded to <ThemeToggle />

description:
Full-width hero banner: eyebrow, headline, subtitle and a pair of CTAs.
All copy and links are supplied by the caller.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small pill of text above the headline

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting copy under the headline

description:
Simple centered page header used on content pages (About, legal
documents, etc.): an optional eyebrow line, a large title and an
intro paragraph inside a glass panel.

props.name: intro
props.description: Supporting intro paragraph under the heading

props.name: title
props.description: Page heading

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Optional small line above the title, e.g. "Updated 1 July 2026"

description:
Stack of titled article cards, one per section. Used for the About
page's "what we do" style sections and for legal document bodies.

props.name: sections
props.description: Sections rendered as a vertical stack of cards, in order

description:
Page chrome shared by every route: decorative aurora background, sticky
header, main content slot and footer. All copy/links are passed in via
`header` and `footer` so this component has no i18n dependency of its own.

props.name: children
props.description: Page content rendered between the header and footer

props.name: footer
props.description: Data for the footer, forwarded to <Footer />

props.name: header
props.description: Data for the sticky header, forwarded to <Header />

description:
Responsive grid of short value-proposition cards
(3 columns on desktop, stacked on mobile).

props.name: items
props.description: Cards shown in the grid, in display order
